title: Attribute sprint subagents to the item they work
goal: A subagent's usage counts under the item it worked, not under the orchestrator's prompt: kbusage reads a subagent transcript's worktree branch work/<id> (or its own claim work row) in memory and distill adds its counts to that item's work line; the branch name is never written; the rule for main-session prompts that fall in two items' windows is documented in kb/_self/usage.md.

gates.question: A main-session prompt inside two items' windows (an orchestrator holding several claims): where do its tokens go?
options: the sprint's own line, not any item
gates.recommendation: the sprint's own line, not any item
gates.answer: the sprint's own line, not any item
